title: Sensitivity-tiered residency and SCCs coverage experiment for enterprise pricing
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Run an experiment to productize a sensitivity-tiered residency SKU for enterprise customers. Goal: offer discrete pricing and contract language for three sensitivity tiers (Standard, Confidential, Regulated) that map to different data residency, retention, and subprocessor commitments, and to surface SCCs (EU/UK) activation as a configurable option. Deliverables: contract snippet templates, SKU pricing deltas, sales quoting integration, a legal-reviewed SCC activation flow, and a pilot with 3 enterprise customers. This ticket coordinates PM, Legal, Sales Engineering, and Engineering workstreams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Legal-approved contract snippets for three sensitivity tiers including SCC language where applicable. 2) Pricing model (base + residency delta) documented with ARR impact scenarios. 3) Quoting tool integration prototype that can toggle residency/SCC flags and produce line-item pricing. 4) Pilot onboarding checklist executed with at least 1 customer for each tier. 5) Telemetry and reporting to measure conversion and uplift by tier.
success_metrics: - Pilot conversion: >= 30% of pilot prospects accept a residency add-on. - Quoting time reduced: average time to generate legal-ready quote <= 2 days. - ARR lift: projected incremental ARR >= $250k from first 6 customers adopting 'Regulated' tier. - Legal sign-off: contract snippets approved and placed in central contract repo.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Define tier criteria, draft contract snippets, initial pricing deltas. Phase 2 (3 weeks): Legal review & iterate; engineering to expose residency/SCC flags in quoting API; implement telemetry events. Phase 3 (4 weeks): Sales pilot with 3 customers, collect feedback, finalize SKUs and rollout packaging in self-serve console. Rollback plan: default to existing residency options and pause quoting integration if legal objections arise.
engineering_notes: Audit current subprocessor catalog and export CSV with region and retention capabilities.
Add 'residency_tier' and 'scc_active' boolean to quoting API payload; ensure backward compatibility.
Produce telemetry events: quote_generated, residency_flag_set, contract_snippet_selected, pilot_onboarded.
Schema for retention SLA fields: retention_days, deletion_process_desc; expose in API and console.
Estimate: small backend API changes + 1 frontend screen for sales quoting (3 story points backend, 2 frontend).
product_notes: Sensitivity tiers defined: Standard (default, no residency guarantees), Confidential (EU/UK data pinned, 30-day retention options), Regulated (SCCs + dedicated subprocessor attestation + customizable retention).
Pricing approach: base per-token pricing + additive residency delta (listed per-region). Evaluate tiered vs percentage markup during price modeling.
We will support SCC auto-activation for customers selecting Regulated tier; legal to provide activation trigger language and audit logs requirement.
Key risk: increased unit costs for Regulated tier may limit adoption; mitigations include limited-time discounts and bundling with dedicated capacity offers.
